notes: No Pet Care category exists on fabindia.com. Access: direct HTTP fetch worked throughout (no WAF/bot-block; robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow). Checked three independent sources: (1) Full mega-menu nav tree extracted from the homepage's ng-state JSON (cx-state.cms.components.entities.FabHamBurgerComponent.component.navigationNode) - 251 lines covering every top-level section (New Arrivals, Women, Men, Kids, Home & Living [incl. Lighting/Kitchen & Dining/Home Decor/Floor Coverings/Storage & Utility/Accessories/Gifting], Furniture, Food, Shop By Collection, Shop By Brand, Sale, Services, Gift Cards, FAQs, Contact Us) - no Pet/Pets/Pet Care node anywhere. (2) Free-text site search via the OCC REST API (apisap.fabindia.com/occ/v2/fabindiab2c/products/search) for query=pet, dog, cat bowl, pet bed, pet care, pet food - all returned either fuzzy/irrelevant word-partial matches (e.g. 'pet' matched 'PET' fabric material in a dhurrie name; 'cat bowl'/'pet bed'/'pet care' matched unrelated serving bowls, human beds, and Ayurvedic health capsules on the word 'care'/'bed'/'bowl' alone) or, for query=dog, 3 genuine 'Dog Toy' products (cotton/poly-filled) plus a Dog-design Rakhi - verified via the product page breadcrumb (BreadcrumbList JSON-LD) that the Dog Toy sits under Home & Living > Accessories > Games & Toys, i.e. a dog-shaped plush toy for children, not a pet product - excluded per 'pet-themed is not pet care' rule. This confirms the site search is non-discriminating (matches individual words), consistent with the false-absence-test pattern, so nav-tree + sitemap were used as the authoritative check rather than search alone. (3) sitemap-category.xml (27303 lines) grepped case-insensitively for 'pet' - only false match was 'petticoats' (women's clothing), no pet-care category URLs. Fabindia is confirmed (per prior Home-Decor pass, archive c280) to be an apparel/textile/home-goods/food retailer with no pet products vertical. No rows to emit; qty=0 category dropped per spec.
